raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice: a second load at 05:00 re-sent all 378 rows with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716186000 = 2026-01-18 06:03:06 UTC, which matches the original row). That broke the TIMESTAMP cast and would also double-count transactions. The fix parses epoch-ms values as UTC and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH dedup AS (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC, batch_id ASC) = 1), parsed AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM dedup) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
